title: Mmaratoto a Ɛwɔ Mpoano
intro: Wogyina mpoano bi a werɛ afi anhwea so, baabi a asorɔkye bɔ ​​ɔmanfo bi a ɔsoro ahyɛde bi asɔ wɔn ahwɛ no asereserew. Mframa no mu yɛ duru a wɔkae mmara so bu bi a ɛde nsakrae a ɛyɛ nwonwa bae. Henanom ne akra yi, na na wɔn sɔhwɛ no su te dɛn?
clues: Na yɛyɛ mpɔtam a yɛnya mmarahyɛ a ɛda adi pefee firii yɛn Awurade hɔ, nanso yɛnya akwan a yɛbɛfa so atia.
Ná yɛte bɛn nsu bi, na na yɛn asetrade gyina n’abɔde so.
Sɔhwɛ bi baa yɛn so da a wɔhyɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnkwati wiase nneɛma akyi no.
Nsu no mu abɔde baa yɛn nkyɛn bebree saa da no ara, na wɔsɔɔ yɛn hwɛe sen boasetɔ.
Yɛyɛɛ anifere kwan bi de twaa ɔsoro nhyehyɛe no ho hyia, na yesusuwii sɛ yebetumi adi ahyɛde no so anifere.
Yɛn mmarato no de nsakrae a ɛyɛ animguase bae; yɛbɛyɛɛ akraman a wɔbu yɛn animtiaa ɛnam Allah ahyɛdeɛ so.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
